cards.card_text: Same question, one word swapped: 'Surely not I, Rabbi?'
cards.verse_text: Then Judas, who would betray Him, said, “Surely not I, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said it yourself.”
cards.snippet: Then Judas, who would betray Him, said, “Surely not I, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said it yourself.”

cards.card_text: Judas asks Jesus, 'Surely not I, Rabbi?' How does Jesus answer him?

cards.card_text: "Greetings, Rabbi!" he says, and he kisses Him.
cards.verse_text: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
cards.snippet: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed Him.

cards.verse_text: Peter remembered it and said, “Look, Rabbi!
cards.snippet: Peter remembered it and said, “Look, Rabbi!

cards.card_text: Jesus asks the two followers, "What do you want?" They call Him "Rabbi" (which means Teacher) and ask Him something back.
cards.verse_text: They said to Him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are You staying?”
cards.snippet: They said to Him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are You staying?”

cards.card_text: He opens with, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God.” That's a BIG opener, and in all my years in the back of a junk drawer, the nicest thing anybody ever said to me was “Scoot over.”
cards.verse_text: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God.
cards.snippet: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God.

cards.card_text: So John's disciples go to him and call him Rabbi.
cards.verse_text: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”

cards.card_text: They find Jesus on the other side of the sea and ask, "Rabbi, when did You get here?" That's the face you make when the last bus left WITHOUT your coworker, and somehow he's at his desk before you.
cards.verse_text: When they found Him on the other side of the sea, they asked Him, “Rabbi, when did You get here?”
